prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / style-transfer.
Create one distinct premium alternative to the supplied selected TRAYN Radiance Cafe Latte package. The reference is the APPROVED BASE direction. Retain the luminous ivory cylindrical food tin, brushed champagne-gold metal lid and base rim, precise TRAYN symbol and TRAYN NUTRITION wordmark, and especially the exact expressive flowing coffee-brown Radiance wordmark with its recognizable sweeping R. Keep Cafe Latte as the flavor and keep its food/nutrition identity clear.
Art direction: QUIET GOLD. Restrained, exceptionally luxurious DAILY NUTRITION packaging. Warmth through beautiful materials and sunlight. This is a product for middle-aged and older men and women; mature, gender-neutral, confident, easy to read.
Make a meaningfully new label design with strict visual restraint:
- Main surface is luminous warm ivory with an extremely fine tactile uncoated-paper texture. Remove ALL decorative botanical border imagery from the source. An immaculate calm field with ample open space, never a sterile stark white field.
- A smaller well-balanced TRAYN identity sits in the upper quarter, with original logo geometry intact. The selected custom Radiance calligraphy stays prominent and dark coffee-brown, gently spaced away from the brand and DAILY PROTEIN. Keep the lettering extremely legible.
- Replace the dense central gold sunburst medallion with a SINGLE LARGE very subtle blind-embossed sun disc positioned slightly off center toward the right in the lower-middle field, partly wrapping around the tin. A few restrained thin champagne-gold rays follow the disc's edge. The motif should be discovered in the grazing light, elegant and tactile rather than an emblem stamped over the copy.
- Use a straight narrow cafe-creme panel around the bottom 20% of the label, bounded by one fine champagne-foil rule. NO sweeping diagonal ribbons, painted scenery, floral wallpaper, colorful gradients or illustrated landscapes.
- In that lower panel, set CAFE LATTE in beautifully aligned dark coffee-brown small caps at left, with 500 g and Contains Milk clearly beneath. At right, a small exquisitely engraved sepia ceramic latte cup and saucer, visible fine latte-art foam and just two roasted coffee beans. This is PRINTED ON THE LABEL. Make this illustration about HALF the visual prominence of the original source's large cup, with plenty of surrounding open space. No botanical sprig or blossoms.
- Fine gold details and restrained espresso ink carry the luxury. Use intentional clean alignment and breathing room. Keep the small bottom notice PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE.
Exact required text: TRAYN NUTRITION, Radiance, DAILY PROTEIN, CAFE LATTE, 500 g, Contains Milk, PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE. No new copy or badges.
Photograph the whole tin with comfortable breathing room and a very subtle three-quarter turn. Pale warm limestone surface, an airy warm-ivory studio background, soft morning sunlight from one side and subtle window-cast shadows, quiet reflected champagne glow, physically believable metal highlights and tactile label detail. The light feels welcoming and sunshiny without an intense yellow cast. Crisp readable package. No props, physical cup, plants, people or extra packages. Premium contemporary food product photography, not cosmetics, not a medicine bottle, not a poster or collage.
Preserve the selected custom Radiance lettering and TRAYN branding, not a generic substitute. No health claims, diabetes claims, nutrition numbers, certification seals or unsupported claims. Output one photorealistic portrait 2:3 render.
formulationNote: Packaging concept only; formulation and medical suitability are not established by the artwork.
